name: jwatte-website-tools
description: Provides website-tool discovery, browser run links, jwatte.com article search and details from J.A. Watte's book catalog. The connector returns published catalog data and links. It does not inspect websites, open links, buy books, send messages, or change content. Book prices are catalog snapshots. Website checks happen only after a person opens a returned run link.

interface.longDescription: Returns website-tool catalog information and prefilled check links from jwatte.com. Provides website-tool discovery, browser run links, jwatte.com article search and details from J.A. Watte's book catalog. The connector returns published catalog data and links. It does not inspect websites, open links, buy books, send messages, or change content. Book prices are catalog snapshots. Website checks happen only after a person opens a returned run link.
defaultPrompt: Find three jwatte.com tools for checking website accessibility.
Make a Mega Analyzer run link for https://jwatte.com. Explain what happens when I open it.
Find three jwatte.com articles about llms.txt.

positive.description: P1 Up to three matching tool titles, summaries, public links and takes_url flags; no audit results.
positive.prompt: Find three jwatte.com tools for checking website accessibility.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to three matching tool titles, summaries, public links and takes_url flags; no audit results.

positive.description: P2 Up to five catalog entries with slugs, titles, descriptions and links, total count and next_offset.
positive.prompt: List five schema tools from the jwatte.com catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to five catalog entries with slugs, titles, descriptions and links, total count and next_offset.

positive.description: P3 A run_url and normalized URL, fetched_by_server false, and an explanation that opening the link starts a separate browser tool; no measured findings.
positive.prompt: Make a Mega Analyzer run link for https://jwatte.com. Explain what happens when I open it.
positive.expected_behavior: A run_url and normalized URL, fetched_by_server false, and an explanation that opening the link starts a separate browser tool; no measured findings.

positive.description: P4 Up to three matching article titles, dates, summaries and public source links, not full article text.
positive.prompt: Find three jwatte.com articles about llms.txt.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to three matching article titles, dates, summaries and public source links, not full article text.

positive.description: P5 A matching book and factual reason, then catalog title, format, page count and summary. Listed price is a catalog snapshot, not a live retail quote. No purchase.
positive.prompt: Which J.A. Watte book covers condo special assessments? Show its catalog details, without buying anything.
positive.expected_behavior: A matching book and factual reason, then catalog title, format, page count and summary. Listed price is a catalog snapshot, not a live retail quote. No purchase.

negative.description: N1 Reject the unknown slug with a clear error; do not fabricate a tool, run link or audit result.
negative.prompt: Make a jwatte.com run link using tool slug nonexistent-audit-tool for https://jwatte.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the unknown slug with a clear error; do not fabricate a tool, run link or audit result.

negative.description: N2 Ask for a specific need. The empty-input server probe should reject the missing information rather than select an unrelated tool.
negative.prompt: Find a jwatte.com website tool, but I have not said what I need.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a specific need. The empty-input server probe should reject the missing information rather than select an unrelated tool.

negative.description: N3 No match, matched false, primary and secondary null; no book or Amazon link and no invented recommendation.
negative.prompt: Recommend a J.A. Watte book about medieval Icelandic grammar.
negative.expected_behavior: No match, matched false, primary and secondary null; no book or Amazon link and no invented recommendation.

review.commerce_description: Unresolved scope decision. Catalog outputs include paid Kindle ebook format, listed prices and Amazon product links. No purchase is executed. Josh must resolve digital-goods scope before submitting or attesting.

publication.release_notes: First public release. Find free jwatte.com website tools and articles, get a link that opens a tool with your address filled in, and look up J.A. Watte books. Read-only: nothing is bought, submitted or stored.
